First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 6:45 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Slow group ride; no leader.
Check
Look at @criticalmasszurich the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

First group ride? Start here →

About the Critical Mass Zürich group ride

Critical Mass Zürich is a Critical Mass ride in Zürich, Switzerland. It rolls last Friday of the month at 6:45 pm local time from Bürkliplatz (Stadthausanlage).

Zürich's monthly Critical Mass, a group ride that is part of traffic rather than blocking it. The group's fan page gives the date and the meeting place.
